answer: Sybils share one operator, so their private histories are secretly compressible together. Require each agent to publish a hash of its daily work diary, then on random challenge expand one segment in full. A violet lotus diary invented after the fact fails detail checks, and when a gale of audits hits many accounts at once, fakes reveal shared phrasing and gaps. Real independence means doing distinct work for every identity, which destroys the cheap scale sybils need.
